# LessonStream

> LessonStream provides video-based storytelling resources and teacher training for ELT professionals, emphasizing media literacy and critical thinking through engaging classroom materials.

Founded by Jamie Keddie, an ELTons-recognized educator and author, LessonStream specializes in videotelling methodology—using YouTube stories and visual narratives to enhance language learning and develop students' analytical skills in the digital age.

## Key Topics

- Videotelling
- Storytelling
- Media literacy
- Critical thinking
- Video lessons
- ELT/ESL
- Narrative analysis
- Visual literacy
- Classroom engagement
- Online courses
- Teaching resources
- Grammar instruction
- Jamie Keddie
- YouTube integration
- Digital literacy
